name: Tien Son Cave
summary: Dry cave above the river: climb nearly 600 steps on the same 2.5-hour boat trip as Phong Nha Cave. The open walk is about 400 metres of a cave the park measures at 980 metres. The Vietnamese page charges 80,000 VND to enter, and children under 1.3 metres are free. The boat for both caves is 750,000 VND for up to 12 people. Ask whether you also pay the 150,000 VND Phong Nha entrance.
getThere: Pier at the Tourism Center, then the stair
heroCaption: A visitor with a headlamp on the flowstone inside Tien Son Cave

notice.title: Ask which entrance is on the ticket
notice.body: The Vietnamese page charges 80,000 VND to enter Tien Son. The English boat page charges 150,000 VND to enter Phong Nha and leaves the 80,000 line off. The boat for both caves is 750,000 VND for up to 12 people. Confirm the total at the counter before you climb.

body: Buy the ticket at the Tourism Center and take a boat number at the pier on the left. The boat runs down the Son River for about 30 minutes to the mouth of Phong Nha Cave. You leave the boat there and climb nearly 600 steps. The park puts this cave about 100 metres above Phong Nha Cave, measured vertically. It gives the cave a length of 980 metres. You walk about 400 metres from the entrance. Past that, the page describes a drop of about 10 metres and a further stretch of nearly 500 metres it keeps closed.

Tien Cave and Royal Palace Cave are the dry branches you walk inside Phong Nha Cave on the way back. Tien Son is this upper cave. The park’s account is that a stream cut the Ke Bang limestone, then the rock shifted and left the dry passage up here while the river kept the cave below. The same page times the whole route, boat and stair, at about two and a half hours. That is the clock it also gives the boat cave. Use the morning you already gave the pier.

The Vietnamese page charges 80,000 VND a person to enter, and children under 1.3 metres are free. It also prints a boat at 700,000 VND a round trip and a boat for both caves at 750,000 VND, each for up to 12 people. The English boat page prints the same two boat prices and a Phong Nha entrance of 150,000 VND. It does not print the 80,000 line. Ask at the counter whether you pay both entrances. A Vietnamese guide is 300,000 VND for one cave or 400,000 for two. An English guide is 400,000 VND for one cave or 500,000 for two. Both pages give those guide prices.

figures.caption: Flowstone shelves on the cave floor
figures.alt: Layered flowstone inside Tien Son Cave

gettingThere: The route starts at the Tourism Center, the same counter as Phong Nha Cave. After you pay, the pier is on the left. The park’s about two and a half hours includes the ride down the Son River and the stair at the mouth. How long it takes to reach that counter from a bed in the village is check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the Tourism Center
legs.body: Walk to the pier on the left. The boat runs downstream for about 30 minutes to the Phong Nha mouth, then you climb nearly 600 steps.

legs.heading: From Dong Hoi
legs.body: The park puts Phong Nha Cave, the pier you share, about 50 km from Dong Hoi city. The minutes are check on arrival.

hours: Summer 07:15–16:30. Winter 07:30–15:45. Which months use which clock: Check on arrival.
closed: Open daily. No weekly closing day is published.
admissionNote: Vietnamese park page: entrance 80,000 VND a person. Children under 1.3 m are free for that entrance. Boat service 700,000 VND a round trip for up to 12 people. Boat for Phong Nha and Tien Son together 750,000 VND a round trip for up to 12 people. The English boat page prints the same two boat prices and a Phong Nha entrance of 150,000 VND, children under 1.3 m free. It does not print the 80,000 VND line. The two pages do not say whether you pay both entrances. Ask at the counter. A Vietnamese guide is 300,000 VND for one cave or 400,000 for two. An English guide is 400,000 VND for one cave or 500,000 for two. Both pages agree on the guide prices. No second publisher confirmed the dong figures.
